messages:
Alice (Praxis): Hey team — noticed missing audit events for our workspace between 2025-04-09T02:00Z and 2025-04-09T02:40Z. We need the full audit trail for a BAA addendum review.
Jamie (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, Alice. Can you share a repro and approximate request IDs/times? Also seeing any error codes on your side? :eyes:
Alice (Praxis): Repro steps: call the audit logs API for that range. Getting 401 for a subset, and some 500s. Example curl: 
```
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
  'https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/audit/logs?start=2025-04-09T02:00:00Z&end=2025-04-09T02:40:00Z'
```
Response snippets we captured: 
- 2025-04-09T02:12:03Z -> 401 Unauthorized (body: token invalid)
- 2025-04-09T02:14:21Z -> 500 Internal Server Error (body: "audit-store timeout")
- many later requests returned 200 but missing events for 02:05-02:20 window.
Jamie (Support): Thanks. Looping in eng-oncall and security. @Zoe @Omar can you take a look? deploybot: deploy 2025-04-09/infra-hsm-rotation completed at 02:15Z.
deploybot: rollout_id=infra-hsm-rotation-20250409
Zoe (Eng-Oncall): I'm looking at infra logs now. There's a coordinated HSM cluster firmware update + KMS key rotation at ~02:14Z that triggered short-lived auth failures to the audit-store proxy. See logs: 
```
[02:13:58Z] hsmctl: start rotation job job=rot-20250409
[02:14:12Z] proxy-auth: upstream-kms unavailable, retrying
[02:14:21Z] audit-store: timeout waiting for kms token -> 500
[02:14:55Z] proxy-auth: recovered, auth ok
```
Zoe (Eng-Oncall): That matches the 500 window. The 401s look like clients trying previously cached tokens that were invalidated by rotation.
Tom (SRE): We have backups of audit events (cold storage streams). If events were not written during the 10-30s window they may not exist; but we can attempt replay from the ingest buffer for that time. I'll start a retrieval job for Praxis workspace id w-0192. ETA 3 hours.
Omar (Security): For BAA/audit requests we need to provide: event export, integrity hashes, and proof of key rotation timing. Also need assurance PHI was not exposed in logs beyond retention.
Alice (Praxis): We require the logs intact for compliance. If events truly dropped we need a signed statement and timeline for regulatory filing.
Raj (Acct Exec): Hi Alice — if you prefer we can discuss Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for stricter control over keys and audit retention. Happy to set up a call.
Maya (Legal): Also looped in. We'll need chain-of-custody notes and the exact retention policy in your current contract/BAA addendum. Do you have a signed BAA on file?
Alice (Praxis): We signed the BAA in Jan 2025 but the addendum about extended retention is pending. For now we need the raw events or a formal incident statement.
Jamie (Support): Action items so far: 1) Tom to run ingest buffer replay for w-0192 (ETA 3h). 2) Zoe to confirm HSM/KMS rotation timeline and provide logs + rotation proof. 3) Omar/Maya to draft an incident statement template. 4) Raj to schedule a call re: Private option.
Tom (SRE): Started job id=job-replay-w0192-176512. Pulling from ingest shards 7-9. If replay succeeds, we'll upload export to secure share and notify.
Zoe (Eng-Oncall): Confirming rotation: rotation start 2025-04-09T02:13:57Z, KMS key-v2 activated 2025-04-09T02:15:03Z. I'll attach signed rotation manifest and HSM job ID when ready.
Omar (Security): While we prepare artifacts — please redact any PHI from screenshots. We'll provide integrity hashes (sha256) for exported events.
Maya (Legal): Please include the DPA/BAA reference number in the statement. We'll prepare a short legal attestation if data was lost due to our maintenance, with dates and remediation steps.
Alice (Praxis): Thanks. Also I flagged some billing anomalies when retries happened — saw a spike in request units at 02:14-02:20. Can someone check if customer was billed for failed requests?
Jamie (Support): Good catch. Tom, can billing correlate request logs to chargeable events and flag for credit if appropriate?
Tom (SRE): I'll hand this to billing but preliminary: transient 500s shouldn't be billed; retries that returned 200 may have been billed. I'll export request-id list for billing.
Raj (Acct Exec): I'll coordinate credits if warranted. Alice — I'll follow up 1:1 after we have the export.
deploybot: job job-replay-w0192-176512 status=completed success=true artifacts=/secure-share/w-0192/audit-export-20250409.tar.gz
Jamie (Support): Replay completed and export available. Sharing secure link via DM. :lock:
Zoe (Eng-Oncall): Attached rotation manifest and hsm job logs to the export. rotation-manifest.sha256=3a7f...
Omar (Security): We'll draft the incident statement and attach integrity hashes + timeline. Expect a preliminary statement in ~6 hours.
Maya (Legal): Once we have the artifacts, I'll prepare the attestation for the BAA addendum review.
Alice (Praxis): Appreciate quick response. Putting this on our compliance tracker.
Jamie (Support): Closing out thread for now — will update when legal/security artifacts are ready. :thumbsup:
